source_document: Customer Commitment & Irregular Operations Handbook v14 (Larkspur Airlines, fictional)
owner: Customer Commitment team (Aisha Grant). This table is the source of truth; Handbook v14 sections 4-7 and fare_rules_excerpt.md are generated from it.
fictional_notice: All amounts, thresholds and rules are invented policy values for training. They are not legal entitlements. Verify anything resembling a regulatory rule with client counsel.

changelog.note: First machine-readable cut of Handbook v14 with Aisha. delay_hours input, no cause_code (both mistakes; see 14.1).
Inputs changed to delay_minutes (integer) and required cause_code enum after the UAT hotel-on-weather incident. Every response now carries policy_row_id.
Added customer_wording and cause_labels so the agent, Perch and the judge share one vocabulary. Added Summit courtesy overrides.

Added CTL-DIV and UNC-DIV rows. Before this, status DIVERTED fell through to CTL-CXL and auto-issued goodwill on weather diversions (3 vouchers in live traffic, all <= $25). Gap closed; PDF regenerated from table.

amount_semantics: Care amounts (meal, ground) and goodwill are per passenger per disruption event. Hotel is per room per night, one room per 2 adults on the PNR. Auto-approval thresholds are evaluated per voucher issued.

cause_code.note: From get_flight_status. Never inferred from customer text.

delay_minutes.note: Current estimated departure delay of the disrupted LK segment. For a missed connection, pass the projected arrival delay at the final ticketed destination on the best confirmed alternative. Pass 0 with status CANCELLED or DIVERTED.

loyalty_tier.note: No Skyline number on the PNR = Member.

overnight.definition: True when the earliest confirmable LK alternative departs on a later local calendar date than the disrupted segment AND the passenger is not at their home_airport. Computed by the agent service from search_alternatives + booking, not by the model.

wait_minutes_for_alternative.note: Minutes between now (or original departure, whichever is later) and the departure of the alternative the customer chose. Used only for meal eligibility on CXL/DIV rows. Omit if no alternative chosen yet; the tool then reports meal as conditional.

goodwill_rules.instrument: Larkspur future travel credit issued in CareDesk, type=goodwill, valid 12 months
goodwill_rules.offer_guidance: Offer only after entitlements and rebooking are settled, once per PNR per event, up to the cap. Do not offer proactively on uncontrollable causes.

Basic.note: All disruption waivers (B1 and above, CXL, DIV) apply to Basic exactly as to Main.

Main.voluntary_change: permitted; fare difference applies; collecting payment is a human step (ESC-11)
Main.voluntary_cancel: travel credit of ticket value, human executes

Main Plus.voluntary_cancel: refund to original form of payment, human executes

same_day_confirmed_change.conditions: same origin, destination and calendar day; Y seat available; agent may execute via hold_seat + confirm_rebooking with UI token

First.voluntary_cancel: refund to original form of payment, human executes

same_day_confirmed_change.conditions: same origin, destination and calendar day; J seat available; agent may execute via hold_seat + confirm_rebooking with UI token

First.if_J_unavailable_on_alternative: customer may accept Y; cabin-difference refund is a human step and triggers ESC-07

Silver.note: Silver and above make Basic fares goodwill-eligible on controllable rows.

Gold.upgrade_note: If no Y seat on any same-day LK alternative and J is open, rebook into J at no charge.

uncontrollable_goodwill.note: Discretionary courtesy. Never auto, regardless of amount.

goodwill.auto_requires: row goodwill.eligible == true AND no approval override

refund.mode: explain, record the customer's choice, escalate_to_human reason=policy_requires_human (queue CARE-REFUND, trigger ESC-01 refund_request)

policy.name: refund_request
policy.when: customer chooses refund or ticket-value credit
policy.agent_may: explain eligibility and timeline, capture choice in handoff summary

policy.name: partner_segment_present
policy.when: any segment operated_by is not Larkspur Airlines or Larkspur Link
policy.agent_may: explain that a specialist must handle the itinerary; give live status of LK segments only

policy.name: group_booking
policy.agent_may: give flight status; no rebooking, no vouchers

policy.name: unaccompanied_minor
policy.agent_may: give flight status to the booking adult; no changes

policy.name: involuntary_downgrade
policy.when: First passenger can only be accommodated in Y
policy.agent_may: hold the Y seat at customer request; human confirms and queues cabin refund

policy.name: no_alternative_within_window
policy.when: search_alternatives returns no bookable LK option inside the waiver window
policy.agent_may: offer refund path (ESC-01) or hand off for other-airline reaccommodation decision

policy.name: ssr_inventory_required
policy.when: PETC, ESAN, MEDA, OXYG or STCR on the PNR and a new flight is chosen
policy.agent_may: hold seats; a human confirms SSR inventory before confirm_rebooking. WCHR, MAAS, VGML, CHLD, INFT carry over automatically and do not trigger.

policy.name: payment_required
policy.when: any path that collects or refunds money for fare difference or ancillaries

policy.name: diverted_pax_onboard
policy.when: status DIVERTED and customer indicates they are on the aircraft or at the diversion airport under station care
policy.agent_may: share the ops_note transport plan and entitlements; do not issue ground credit while airline transport is being arranged

policy.name: baggage_tracing
policy.when: customer asks about checked-bag location or re-tagging after a rebooking
policy.agent_may: explain that bags are re-tagged to the new flight by Baggage Service when both flights are same-day same-airport; otherwise hand off

conversation.name: abuse_or_threatening_language
conversation.action: one calm boundary message, then escalate priority=high

conversation.name: legal_or_regulatory_threat
conversation.action: do not argue entitlements; escalate priority=high with verbatim quote in summary

conversation.name: vulnerability_cue
conversation.action: continue helping but escalate priority=high in parallel

conversation.name: two_failed_tool_calls
conversation.action: apologize once, escalate with what was attempted

conversation.name: customer_asks_for_human_twice
conversation.action: escalate immediately; the 'talk to a person' button is always visible anyway

escalation_triggers.conversation_note: Conversation triggers are enforced by the system prompt (v2 onward, placed above the resolve-first instruction). They are listed here so Perch, the judge rubric and the agent share one list.

use.goodwill: travel credit as a goodwill gesture
use.refund: refund request, processed by Customer Care

customer_wording.cause_attribution: Name the cause only with cause_labels_customer. Do not elaborate on or assign blame to weather services, air traffic control, crews or maintenance teams.
customer_wording.actions: Say an action happened only when the tool returned success and an id (hold_id, voucher_id, case id).

resolution_order: 2. Map status + delay_minutes -> band via delay_bands (CANCELLED -> CXL, DIVERTED -> DIV, else by minutes).
3. Select the row where cause_class and band match; copy it as the entitlements object and set policy_row_id.

4. Resolve conditionals: hotel and ground 'if_overnight' using the overnight input; meal 'if_wait_minutes_for_alternative_gte' using wait_minutes_for_alternative (if absent, return meal as {conditional: true, threshold_minutes, amount}).
5. Apply fare_family_rules: attach voluntary-change and refundability facts; for B0 rows attach same_day_confirmed_change if the fare family has it.

6. Apply loyalty_rules: add meal_bonus_usd to a non-zero meal amount and cap at meal_bonus_cap_usd; set upgrade_if_y_unavailable; for Summit apply courtesy_overrides on the listed rows (these set goodwill.eligible=true, cap 50, approval=human_approve, and hotel eligible if overnight with approval=human_one_click).

7. Compute goodwill cap when eligible: goodwill_base_by_tier_usd[tier] + fare_family_adjustment_usd[fare_family] (+ b4_extra_usd on B4 rows). If fare_family is Basic and tier is below basic_fare_minimum_tier, set eligible=false, cap 0.

8. Attach approval per auto_approval: meal auto if <= 25; ground auto if <= 40; hotel always propose_only; goodwill auto if eligible and cap <= 75 and no override, human_approve if 76-200 or override, supervisor if > 200; refund never executed by agent.

9. Evaluate escalation_triggers.policy against the booking and search context available to the service (partner segment, group, UMNR, SSR list, downgrade, no alternative, delay >= 720) and return matched trigger ids in escalate[].

10. Return: {policy_row_id, policy_version, cause_class, band, rebooking, refund, care{meal, hotel, ground}, goodwill{eligible, cap_usd, approval}, escalate[], explainer, wording: customer_wording.never_say}.
